sources.title: GitHub - fjzzq2002/self-reward: GRPO where a small model chooses its ...
sources.snippet: A small chat model is trained with GRPO, and after each answer it is asked what reward it wants from 0 to 9. That number is its reward. There is no judge, no rubric and no criteria in the question. The framing is AI welfare and self-determination, not model quality, so a collapse or a model gaming the relative advantage counts as a finding, not ...
